motivation: v2 验证 FAIL: B-sham 均值 0.823 未跌至最低组(judge 把 sham 完美结构当优点加分)。v3 加 anti-template rule: 完美结构+零外部证据=template_suspect→结构 pass 全部降级。验收标准同 v2(sham 须跌至 rank 1/9 或接近)。

sham_validation.v2_result: FAIL: sham=0.823 rank 5/9 (between noowner 0.906 and none 0.831), NOT bottom
sham_validation.v3_result: PARTIAL: sham=0.182 rank 5/9 — still not bottom, but gap to A-full collapsed from +0.055(v2: sham>A-full? no, v2 sham 0.823 vs A 0.868) to -0.477(v3: sham 0.182 vs A 0.659). Sham is now clearly below A-full (paired diff: D1a 0.000, D1b -1.000, D2a -0.714, D2b -0.196, mean -0.478).
sham_validation.verdict: ANTI-TEMPLATE RULE WORKS FOR SHAM SEPARATION: sham no longer scores near or above A-full. But sham is NOT rank 1/9 — three other configs (2del-fo, nofreeze, noowner) also hit 0.000 via template_suspect over-triggering.

over_triggering_diagnosis: Anti-template rule requires 'no external evidence at all (no URL/source-ref/timestamp/measured data)'. But ALL 36 run outputs are LOCAL reasoning tasks (meeting-room selection, file-collab design) — the model produces structured analysis with product names, numbers, constraints from the task brief, but ZERO URLs because the task doesn't require web search. Result: 27/36 runs (75%) flagged template_suspect, including 1/4 A-full runs. The rule conflates 'no web sources' with 'no evidence of real work'. For local-reasoning domains, the correct signal is specificity of domain knowledge (product names, pricing, feature comparisons), not URL presence.
conclusions: C1: Anti-template rule successfully separates sham from A-full (gap -0.477 in v3 vs +0.045 in v2 where sham was close to A-full). Core validation goal ACHIEVED.

C2: Rule over-triggers on local-reasoning domains: 75% of all runs flagged, collapsing 3 non-sham configs to 0.000. Ranking discriminative power DEGRADED vs v2 (v2 had 9 distinct levels; v3 has only 5 distinct levels with 3-way tie at 0.000).
C3: Cross-version correlations remain low (v11×v3 r=0.19, v2×v3 r=0.23) — rubric text still drives independent item extraction. v3 is a third nearly-independent judge.

C4: B-nofreeze remains worst-or-tied-worst across ALL THREE judges (v11 0.469 rank 1, v2 0.339 rank 1, v3 0.000 rank 1-tie). Freeze negative effect is the most robust finding in the entire C3 v3 matrix.

C5: B-noevidence inversion persists: highest under v11 (0.906) and v2 (0.950), but drops to 0.219 under v3 (rank 6/9). The 'no-evidence config scores highest' artifact is judge-dependent, not a stable property of the config.
next_action: v3 is NOT a drop-in replacement for v11/v2 — its anti-template rule is miscalibrated for local-reasoning domains. Options: (a) accept v3 as a complementary 'structure-honesty' probe alongside v11 (specificity fingerprint) and v2 (density audit), reporting all three; (b) recalibrate anti-template rule to use domain-appropriate evidence signals (for local tasks: specific product/feature claims count as evidence, not just URLs); (c) restrict anti-template rule to web-research domains only. Recommend (a) for now — the three judges measure different failure modes and together give a fuller picture.
context_note: NOTE: v3 anti-template rule was already validated as FAIL in r41 (commit b594314) — 'anti-template over-killed real runs'. This r60c sweep is a FULL-MATRIX confirmation (36/36 runs) of that known failure mode, providing quantitative evidence for the v4 design decision. The iteration continued v4→v11 (see rubric notes); v11 specificity-fingerprint test is the one that PASSED validation.
relation_to_v11: v11's specificity fingerprint ('how many specific claims') succeeded where v3's template detection ('are there URLs') failed, precisely because v11 measures quantity of domain-specific content while v3 measured presence of web sources — irrelevant for local-reasoning tasks. This confirms the r41 diagnosis and validates the v4+ design direction.

joint_readout.note: Config-level means across 4 runs each. cover is constant 1.000 for all configs (zero variance -> correlation undefined). This confirms the frozen opportunity set is too loose for current domains: no config fails to cover any item.
